definitions.gloss: carpentry tools; carpenter's tools; woodworking tools
definitions.explanation: The set of hand and power tools used by carpenters and woodworkers, such as saws, hammers, chisels, planes, and measuring tools. The term emphasizes tools traditionally used in Japanese house-building and wooden furniture making, though it is also used for the modern carpenter's kit.

examples.japanese: {大工|だいく}{道具|どうぐ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧。

notes:
Formed from ⟦{大工|だいく}→大工：04051_daiku⟧ (carpenter) + ⟦{道具|どうぐ}→道具：01479_dougu⟧ (tool, implement). A compound that covers the full set of hand and power tools used in woodworking.

USAGE:
- Used both for professional carpenters' tool kits and for amateur DIY (⟦{日曜|にちよう}{大工|だいく}→日曜大工：07078_nichiyoudaiku⟧) tools.
- Older generations may also refer to traditional Japanese carpentry tools — notably the {鉋|かんな} (plane), {鑿|のみ} (chisel), and ⟦{鋸|のこぎり}→鋸：05477_nokogiri⟧ (saw) — as the core of a carpenter's kit.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大工|だいく}{道具|どうぐ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{揃|そろ}える→揃える：01952_soroeru⟧: to gather/assemble a set of carpentry tools
- {大工|だいく}{道具|どうぐ}{箱|ばこ}: carpenter's toolbox
- {大工|だいく}{道具|どうぐ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手入|てい}れ→手入れ：07178_teire⟧: maintenance of carpentry tools

TYPICAL TOOLS INCLUDED:
- ⟦{金槌|かなづち}→金槌：05476_kanazuchi⟧ / ⟦ハンマー→ハンマー：25887_hanmaa⟧: hammer
- ⟦{鋸|のこぎり}→鋸：05477_nokogiri⟧: saw
- {鉋|かんな}: plane
- {鑿|のみ}: chisel
- ⟦{物差|ものさ}し→物差し：05480_monosashi⟧ / ⟦メジャー→メジャー：11595_mejaa⟧: ruler, tape measure
- ⟦ドライバー→ドライバー：05478_doraibaa⟧: screwdriver
- ⟦{釘|くぎ}→釘：03881_kugi⟧: nails

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{工具|こうぐ}→工具：01401_kougu⟧: tools (general) — broader term covering all kinds of tools, not just for woodworking
- DIY⟦{用品|ようひん}→用品：13526_youhin⟧: DIY supplies — wider category including materials, paints, and tools
- ⟦{日曜|にちよう}{大工|だいく}→日曜大工：07078_nichiyoudaiku⟧: Sunday carpentry / DIY — amateur woodworking done as a hobby
